events.verdict: McCollum (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position during Powell's (LAC) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Powell (LAC) establishes his left foot in bounds before making contact with the rebound and he releases the pass before stepping out of bounds.
Dunn (LAC) commits a take foul on Murphy III (NOP). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Harden (LAC) reaches in and the contact with Murphy III's (NOP) body is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) legally contests Murray's (NOP) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Murray (NOP) is in a legal guarding position when Harden (LAC) enters his upward shooting motion.
Zubac (LAC) and Missi (NOP) get their legs tangled and the contact during the loose ball is incidental.
Missi (NOP) and Dunn (LAC) both pursue the rebound and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Replay review of the foul called on Murray (NOP) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Murray wraps both arms around Harden (LAC), affecting his FOM.
Harden (LAC) makes contact to Missi's (NOP) arm, which affects his play at the basket.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that Missi's (NOP) free throw attempt makes contact with the rim and the game clock is adjusted to 00:04.3. Neither team possesses or imminently possesses the ball at the point of interruption and play resumes with a jump ball.
Jones (NOP) commits a take foul on Harden (LAC).
Jones Jr. (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends McCollum (NOP).
